title: Rollout Lighthouse: telemetry sandbox and triggered rollback scenarios
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Current Console rollout pages focus on per-route metrics and cohort diffs but lack a deterministic sandbox and policy preview that lets PMs/Engineers simulate a canary/A-B/shadow rollout and observe the exact signals that would trigger auto-rollback or escalation.

Goal: Build a "Rollout Lighthouse" — a telemetry sandbox in Console that: (1) replays representative traffic slices against candidate variants, (2) surfaces per-route and per-cohort diffs with hypothesis labels, (3) previews auto-rollback triggers and suggested mitigation actions, and (4) provides an audit trail + links to trace spans, PRs, and alert runbooks.

Scope: Console UX + telemetry pipelines + policy simulation endpoint. MVP will support HTTP/text generation routes, existing cohort definitions, and the current auto-rollback rule set. Integrations with shadow replay, trace linking, and signal attribution are included in scope.

Out of scope for MVP: live synthetic traffic injection into production; per-token cost optimization for replay (follow-up project).
acceptance_criteria: Console contains a Rollout Lighthouse workspace accessible from a deployment detail page
Users can select up to 3 variants and a saved cohort or a custom traffic slice to simulate
Simulation runs produce a per-metric diff table (latency P95, error rate, hallucination rate, throughput) and a ranked list of contributing traces
Policy simulator evaluates existing auto-rollback rules and returns the would-be action (no-op, warn, rollback) with the matched rule and threshold values
Telemetry artifacts (cohort snapshot, simulation result, matched policy) are persisted and linked to the deployment timeline for auditing
There is a CLI/SDK endpoint for engineering to run the same simulation in CI with a reproducible result ID
Design sign-off on UX flows and developer sign-off on API contracts are documented and attached
tasks: Define simulation input schema and map to existing cohort definitions (ENG + PM) - owner: ENG
Backend: implement policy-simulator service that evaluates rollback rules against simulated metrics - owner: ENG
Telemetry: add a simulated-trace tagging layer so the Lighthouse can surface representative spans - owner: ENG
Frontend: Lighthouse workspace mockups & interactive prototype - owner: DESIGN
Frontend: implement simulation run UI, diff table, and rule-match callouts - owner: ENG/PM
Persist simulation runs to Console history and link to rollout timeline - owner: ENG
Add CLI/SDK binding for reproducible simulation runs - owner: ENG
QA: create smoke tests and a CI job that runs the simulator against canned cohorts - owner: QA
Create runbook and internal docs for interpreting Lighthouse output - owner: PM
discussion: 2026-02-18 Maya Chen: Initial writeup. Proposal to call this 'Lighthouse' to emphasize synthetic, deterministic guidance rather than production traffic. Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RDO/PM-45219+Rollout+Lighthouse

2026-02-22 Liam O'Connor: Eng spike started to assess telemetry cost for replay. Found that full token-level replay for long chats is expensive; recommend sampling prefixes for hallucination evaluation.
2026-02-25 Priya Shah (Design): Attached Figma prototype for simulation workspace. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/lighthouse-prototype
2026-02-28 Jonah Park (SRE): Policy-simulator must run sandboxed with rate limits to avoid DB hotspots. Also suggested a cached delta view for repeated runs.
2026-03-03 Maya Chen: Updated acceptance criteria to require CLI/SDK reproducibility after review with Developer Experience team.

2026-03-06 Liam O'Connor: Backend spike results uploaded. GitHub draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rdo-console/pull/1827. Summary: initial simulator MVP returns metric buckets and matched-rule metadata.
2026-03-09 Priya Shah (Design): UX iteration - added 'explain' hover on matched-policy rows that surfaces contributing metrics and example prompts/traces.
2026-03-10 Natasha Ivanov (Security): Quick review for retention of simulation artifacts. No PII expected; retention policy recommended 90 days by default.
notes: Design constraint: prioritise compact diff table for at-a-glance decisions; details expandable to compare histograms and token-level scatterplots
Implementation note: reuse existing cohort snapshot API to seed simulations to reduce new surface area
Fallback behavior: if policy-simulator cannot evaluate due to missing signals, show 'insufficient data' with suggestions (increase sample size, include shadow-replay)
